title: PSA 10 C.J. Stroud 2023 Panini Donruss - Rated Rookie #339 (RC) Texans
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This PSA 10 C.J. Stroud 2023 Panini Donruss Rated Rookie #339 sports trading card is a must-have for any Houston Texans fan. The card features the highly-touted rookie quarterback, C.J. Stroud, and is part of the 2023 Panini Donruss base set.

This card is a National Football League (NFL) standard size and is manufactured in the United States. It is unsigned and comes with Donruss autograph authentication. As a part of the Donruss parallel/variety, this card is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. Get your hands on this rare card and add it to your collection today!
